description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.
The domain name to which the API operation belongs.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. Paging starts from page 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page. Paging starts from page 1.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh:
敏感数据类型。
> 您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~)获取支持敏感数据类型。
description.en:
The sensitive data type.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported sensitive data types.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The start time of the query, in UNIX timestamp (UTC) format. Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 查询敏感数据的访问日志信息
title.en: Query access logs of sensitive data

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-request-log --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --start-time 1723392000 --end-time 1726057800 --matched-host a.000.com --api-format /api/users/login --client-ip 103.118.55.00 --sensitive-code 1000,1001 --sensitive-data user --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id 433 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --account admin --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeSensitiveRequestLog --region cn-hangzhou --Account admin --EndTime 1726057800 --SensitiveCode '1000,1001' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --ClusterId 433 --ApiFormat '/api/users/login' --SensitiveData user --StartTime 1723392000 --ClientIP '103.118.55.00' --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --MatchedHost 'a.000.com' --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
